newsitem.title: USA: Iacocca firm buys stake in Unique Mobility.
newsitem.headline: Iacocca firm buys stake in Unique Mobility.

text.p: Former Chrysler Corp. Chairman Lee Iacocca's plan to sell electric scooters took another step forward Thursday when his new firm, EV Global Motors, acquired a stake in an electric motor company based in Colorado.
Unique Mobility Inc. said it set a partnership with EV Global to develop electric drive systems for bikes, scooters and other light vehicles.

In a statement, Unique said EV Global Motors bought about 1.1 million shares of Unique stock in a private transaction from Alcan Aluminum Ltd. and purchased warrants from other sources for an additional 350,000 shares.

Separately, Unique has agreed to acquire 400,000 shares of EVG in exchange for an additional 200,000 newly issued shares of Unique. The moves will make EVG the largest shareholder of Unique with about 12.2 percent of the firm.

Iacocca, best known from steering Chrysler back from the brink of bankruptcy, formed EV Global in March to develop and market light electric transportation systems such as bicycles and scooters in North America, Europe and Asia.

EVG has selected Unique to make an electric drive system for bicycles and has signed agreements with Unique and Unique's Taiwan joint venture partners to market electric scooters throughout the Western Hemisphere.

"We're excited about teaming up with Unique Mobility," Iacocca said in a statement. "As a product development and manufacturing partner, Unique will become an important supplier of electric drive systems for our new products."

Iacocca will join Unique's board of directors and Unique Chairman Ray Geddes will sit on EVG's board. For 20 years, Iacocca and Geddes worked together at Ford Motor Co. on several sports car projects, including the Shelby Cobra, the Shelby Mustangs, the Ford GT LeMans car and the Ford Pantera.

"Lee Iacocca's expertise in marketing and management will jump-start our growth as a power system supplier and will provide a welcome boost for the entire electric vehicle industry," Geddes said. "Like Lee, I believe the worldwide potential for light electric transportation is enormous."
Unique Mobility, based in Golden, Colo., provides electric motors and controllers for electric and hybrid electric vehicle propulsion systems.
